blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Catacombs, subway interchanges, lava tubes, mining galleries, cave pilgrimage routes, and railway tunnels whose branches become understandable through sound and signs rather than open sightlines.
World relation: Pilgrim World navigation supported by Continuity responses and Quiet World restrictions.
Connection to newer locations: It connects Corridor Twelve to the Alpine Bell Pass, Stair of Thin Air, Karst Lantern Provinces, Pale Concordance Station, and Plain of Missing Distance.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: The right path is not simply the fastest path. Travel becomes possible when the route recognizes the traveler and the traveler learns how to answer.
